fact: The ICT minister said the law-enforcement digital system was completed 100% in phases one and two in 7 governorates (Cairo, Giza, Suez, Alexandria, Ismailia, Matrouh, Port Said), in police stations, markaz and posts, prosecutions, courts and forensic medicine, with remaining governorates to follow in phases three and four.
title: وزير الاتصالات: الانتهاء من تطبيقات ميكنة دورات العمل بوزارتي الداخلية والعدل
